test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
6 persons S, O, K, U, T and A are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). S is sitting second to the right of A. Only one person is sitting between O and U. T is sitting to the immediate right of K. Only two persons are sitting between O and A.

Who is sitting third to the left of K ?
solution:
Given: 6 persons S, O, K, U, T and A.

1) S is sitting second to the right of A.

2) Only two persons are sitting between O and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a873fb8ded7bf7db6e132d7500c0984e2fe50fd0205c92653db52c422f7c739.png] 

3) T is sitting to the immediate right of K.

4) Only one person is sitting between O and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79fdc61957c1d4c135245d1f8c873af0a731582509d3f6dfb7fbbe638a8cf356.png] 

So, 'U' is sitting third to the left of K.

Hence, the correct answer is **"U"**.
